info.title: Traqen Traceability API
info.description: API for project and Snapshot bootstrap, deterministic fact ingestion, controlled Reverse Skill runs, authorized statement-level governance, server-derived Feature traceability, layered Snapshot impact, TestSpec validation, and attested execution Evidence ingestion. The production server requires an API token; Decision and candidate-review operations additionally fail closed without configured reviewer identity.

BearerAuth.description: Production API token. Reviewer routes can instead reserve Authorization for reviewer identity and send the API token through ApiToken.

SourceSliceWorkerCredential.name: x-traqen-worker-credential
SourceSliceWorkerCredential.description: Short-lived, single-use server-attested credential bound to one active job, WorkUnit, selected RouteDecision, producer, Snapshot and source policy. It is never issued to browser clients.

SourceSliceWorkerCredential.name: x-traqen-worker-credential
